findings: GET /api/projects has no isAdminAuthorized check — all client PRD records (client name, email, prd_content, blockers) are returned to any unauthenticated HTTP caller. Fix: add the x-admin-key guard at the top of the GET handler, matching the pattern already on POST and PATCH.

The Converted lead status is unreachable from the employee update flow. deriveStatus() in app/api/leads/[id]/route.ts never returns 'Converted', and LeadUpdateModal has no control for it. EmployeeStats computes a conversion rate against this status, so it will always show 0. Fix: add a 'Mark as converted' mechanism in the employee modal or admin LeadsTable and handle it in the API.
